scope: Two fixed new actual-poset controls only; not an enumeration of poset space.

structure.relations: a<z; every D element is below every C_m element; every D,C_m,z element is below every element of the 30-point chain U; the C_m and U elements have their chain orders. No other comparabilities except transitive consequences.

method: Enumerate only the 5/6-point core D+C_m+z, append the fixed U chain, and insert isolated y in every slot. The sum of the rank of a in core words counts the failures y<a.
